text:
maria: Originate RC rc-20240321 at artifact sha:abc123def. Quiet window starts 02:00 UTC. Asking for quick sheriffs + QA ack — this is a lateflip with a config tweak to kv-warm. Can we get a short approval chain? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: [CI] rc-20240321 build passed. Tests: unit ✅ integration ✅ smoke ✅. Deploy window open at 02:00 UTC. Attach release notes: https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20240321

jason: migrating the KV schema tweak included? any DB migration locking?

maria: @jason no DB migration. just runtime config change and a tiny perf patch. Verified in staging with kv warm set to 256MB.

anna: QA quick check: ran full smoke on staging; no regressions on reranking suite. metrics: latency +3ms, p50 unchanged, 99th slight uptick but within SLO. I'm +1 for canary. :white_check_mark:

sheriff: I'm on duty for the quiet window. need commit hash and rollback plan before giving go. Also attach rollback playbook path.

maria: commit sha: abc123def. Rollback plan: instant pin to rc-stable (artifact sha:ff0e11a) + routing fallback to smaller model variant. Playbook: /playbooks/rollback-rc.md.

ci-bot: Preflight checks: KV warm cache warmup observed in staging (warm fraction 98%). Canary test traffic harness ok. Canary health checks configured.

jason: Confirming feature flags: feature flag kv_warm_config flipped only for rc nodes? we should ensure no global flip.

maria: yes flags are scoped to traffic group 'rc-canary'. snippet: `flags.kv_warm_config = { scope: "rc-canary" }`

deploy-bot: To initiate promotion, run the promote command. Example:
```
/deploy promote --env=prod --rc=rc-20240321 --artifact=sha:abc123def \n  --canary-stages=5,25,100 --quiet-window=02:00-03:00UTC \n  --notify=@sheriff --notes-url=https://go.internal/release-notes/rc-20240321
```

anna: small request — start at 5% for 10m, then 25% for 20m, then full if no alerts. Watch rerank latency and hallucination evals.

sheriff: I'll watch metrics and have the oncall pager ready. If error rate >2% or p99 latency +40% -> abort and rollback.

maria: ok I'm going to kick it now. tagging @deploy-bot for the promote.

deploy-bot: ACTION by maria: scheduled promotion at 02:05 UTC. Starting canary in 10m. Canary plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Health probes: endpoint /health, token-level cost probe, and eval set run every stage.

deploy-bot: Stage 1: deploying canary nodes (5%)... done. Traffic routed. Health: passing. Telemetry: no errors.

anna: smoke passes against canary. No regressions in top10 prompts.

ci-bot: Canary eval run: 0.2% auto-diff failures (within baseline). No regression alerts.

deploy-bot: Stage 2: moving to 25% traffic. Deploying... routing updated. Health: passing.

sheriff: watching. p99 latency stable, error rate 0.6%. keeping eyes. :binoculars:

maria: if all good after 18m we go to 100%.

deploy-bot: Stage 3: promoting to 100% traffic. Rolling update across regions. This may take ~6m.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. All regions at rc-20240321 artifact sha:abc123def. Post-deploy checks: OK.

jason: Verified service metrics and infra. DB connections normal. No increased retries.

anna: running extended evals now. will report if anything odd. so far so good. :+1:

sheriff: formally approving final promotion. Marking thread as stable.

maria: Thanks team. Closing quiet window early at 02:45 UTC since all good. I'll update release notes with canary timings.

deploy-bot: Noting closure: quiet window ended 02:45 UTC. Recording rollout timeline.

ci-bot: Postdeploy synthetic tests running (30m window). If any regression detected will auto-open a rollback ticket.

anna: small follow-up: noticed a 0.3% drop in rerank exact-match for a specific prompt. creating a quick eval ticket: https://go.internal/issue/EV-4521

maria: thanks @anna. we'll triage but not rollback unless severity rises. Keep this thread updated.

deploy-bot: Reminder: rollback command if needed:
```
/deploy rollback --env=prod --to-artifact=sha:ff0e11a --reason="regression EV-4521"
```

sheriff: copy. I'll escalate if the metric drift crosses threshold.

maria: final note: changelog entry updated and release notes posted. great job everyone. :tada:
